newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam reports three new executions.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam reports three new executions.

text.p: Vietnam executed three men at the weekend following their conviction on separate charges of rape, murder and drug-trafficking, a court official in Ho Chi Minh City said on Monday.
The official, who declined to be named, confirmed news reports that the three men had been executed by firing squad in a field in Ho Chi Minh City's Thu Duc district, a semi-rural area.
Newspapers named the three as a Hanoi resident, Tran Dinh Nhan, and Nguyen Minh Hoang and Nguyen Quoc Thang, both residents of the southern city.
Vietnam has broken with former practice in recent weeks by reporting a number of executions and publishing photographs of both condemned people and -- in one case -- an actual execution.
